theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ r, IsRectifiableTriple U n (M r) (θ r) (ξ r)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ x in M r ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ r x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) < ∞) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * tauAction n (M r) (θ r) (ξ r) ω) (∫ x, ∑' r, (M r).indicator (fun y => (c r : ℝ) * (θ r y * ξ r y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y))) x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))
